Put slideshow images in this folder.

Required dimensions: 1600 x 900 pixels (16:9).
Preferred format: WebP. Use JPG only if needed.
Keep important text or logos away from the outer 10% of the image so mobile crops remain safe.

Required filenames:
trex-iptv.webp
8k-strong.webp
ultra-8k-ott.webp
dino-iptv.webp
lion-ott.webp
nexon-iptv.webp
tivione.webp
eagle-iptv.webp
mega-ott.webp
crystal-ott.webp
magnum-golden-ott.webp
infinity-iptv.webp
max-ott.webp
dream-4k-iptv.webp
promax-4k-ott.webp
